page.content:
Shared vocabulary of fruit, oak, acid, and scores that mediates wine talk.

How Tasting-note culture connects

  • Character: Robert Parker — Parker's scores and paragraphs trained late-century tasting-note culture.
  • Topic: Sommelier — Sommeliers speak the shared vocabulary of tasting notes at the table.
  • Topic: Oak aging — Barrel toast is a standing category in tasting notes.

What is Tasting-note culture?

Tasting notes — cassis, wet stone, 95 points — are how journals, sommeliers, and labels teach people to remember a glass. Robert Parker popularized the score; villages still resist being only a number.

Key threads lead to Robert Parker, Sommelier and Oak aging.
